Reauthentication, through periodic identity verification, offers a proactive solution, significantly reducing unauthorized access and fraudulent activities. In today's digital age, businesses must prioritize robust security measures like reauthentication to safeguard sensitive information, mitigate risks, and uphold trust in an interconnected world.

## Understanding ReAuthenticateTM

At its core, ReAuthenticateTM, with its world-classIdentity Verification APIs, faster eKYCs & other tools, is a security mechanism designed to repeatedly verify your identity during a single session or after a certain period. Unlike traditional login processes, which grant access based on initial authentication alone, ReAuthenticateTM adds an extra layer of protection by periodically prompting your users to confirm their identity and protect your business from identity theft. This simple yet powerful process is a bulwark against unauthorized access and malicious activities, varying from data breaches to Synthetic identity frauds to Biometric spoofing.
